title: Jacobs selected for major New Zealand highway project
summary: Jacobs has been selected by ACCIONA to provide multidisciplinary design and project delivery services for the Warkworth to Te Hana Ara Tūhono section of New Zealand's Northland Corridor highway program.
body_markdown:
DALLAS –


[Jacobs](http://www.jacobs.com/) (NYSE: J) has been selected by ACCIONA to provide multidisciplinary design and project delivery services for the Warkworth to Te Hana Ara Tūhono section of New Zealand's Northland Corridor highway program. The program is expected to improve travel reliability, safety and resilience, strengthen freight connections, and support communities


between Auckland and Northland.


As the country's largest public-private partnership transportation infrastructure project, it includes approximately 16 miles (26 kilometers) of four-lane expressway, grade-separated interchanges at Warkworth, Wellsford and Te Hana, twin tunnels through Dome Valley and 15 bridges.


The New Zealand government estimates the project's total value at approximately US$2.1 billion (NZ$3.6 billion).


Jacobs will design all 15 bridges, the utility relocations and building facilities packages. Work includes design management, geotechnical engineering, digital engineering and building services.


**Jacobs Executive Vice President Sinead Giblin said:** "Reliable transportation networks are essential to the long-term prosperity of communities and economies. This project will help to improve mobility, strengthen network resilience and support future growth across northern New Zealand. By combining integrated design, digital delivery and multidisciplinary engineering services, Jacobs will contribute to creating infrastructure that provides lasting value for the people, businesses and communities that depend on this route every day."


Warkworth to Te Hana forms the first section of the wider Northland Corridor and is classified as a Road of National Significance on the country's state highway network.


**ACCIONA Managing Director Construction for Australia and New Zealand José Angel Andrés López said:** "The Warkworth to Te Hana project represents much more than a new motorway. It is an investment in the people, businesses and communities that rely on safe and reliable transport connections every day. ACCIONA is proud to combine local capability with global expertise to deliver this transformative project for New Zealand. We are delighted to welcome Jacobs to the team and look forward to drawing on their industry-leading expertise as we bring this vision to life."


Ranked No. 2 in Transportation by


[Engineering News-Record](https://www.jacobs.com/about/industry-recognition) , Jacobs delivers complex transportation programs that improve mobility, resilience and connectivity. In New Zealand, projects include the Northwest Busway,


[Eastern Busway](https://www.jacobs.com/projects/reshaping-travel-18000-people-east-auckland) and


[Auckland Northern Corridor Improvements program](https://www.jacobs.com/projects/northern-corridor-success-expanding-connections-and-communities-auckland) , and globally New York’s


[Grand Central Madison program](https://www.jacobs.com/projects/grand-central-madison) and Penn Station Access and


[the Elizabeth line](https://www.jacobs.com/depth/depth-supporting-delivery-elizabeth-line) in the U.K., connecting communities and supporting sustainable economic growth.

From advisory and consulting, feasibility, planning, design, program and lifecycle management, we’re creating a more connected and sustainable world. See how at
